siteEffect.title: Tet effect

tet.name: Lunar New Year peach blossoms
tet.description: Peach blossom petals gently fall across the whole yp.vn website, with two blossom branches hanging from the top corners. Content stays clickable; no impact on speed or SEO.

siteEffect.delayNote: Saved. Reload yp.vn to see the change.
siteEffect.noPermission: View only. Banner management permission is needed to turn it on or off.
siteEffect.previewNote: Visitors cannot turn it off; only here. With reduced motion, petals do not fall but the branches stay. Phones (under 640px) get falling petals only, no branches.
